craft_notes: Sthāyin: night mirror. Rows: sides then night. Read aloud: pendulum by dark.

lines: Then too right, left, right, left, right — five crossings, nine hundred apiece —
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato 'pi dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe iti saṃkrāntipañcakaṃ pratyekaṃ navaśatāni ity evaṃ rātrāv api iti
